reasons.blurnoise_noise_alpha: Noise Alpha's values come from After Effects' own random generator; ours are a seeded look-alike
reasons.blurnoise_noise_hls: Noise HLS's values come from After Effects' own random generator; ours are a seeded look-alike
reasons.blurnoise_noise_hls_auto: Noise HLS Auto's values come from After Effects' own random generator; ours are a seeded look-alike
reasons.blurnoise_turbulent: Turbulent Noise's lattice comes from After Effects' own random tables; ours is fractal.ts's hashed lattice
reasons.blurnoise_grain: Add Grain's grain comes from its own random generator and film-stock models; ours is a seeded look-alike
